values.title: Principles I keep coming back to

items.description: I try to reduce ambiguity with clear language and break complex problems into parts people can reason about together.

items.title: Optimize for maintainability
items.description: I prefer structures that can evolve over time instead of short-term delivery that leaves hidden complexity behind.

items.title: Write things down
items.description: I want experience to become reusable context, not something that only exists in one person's memory.

interests.title: Themes that keep me engaged

items.title: Systems and business structure

A lot of my energy goes into making complexity feel more intentional and manageable.

items.title: Reading and expression
points: Reading lets me borrow other people's experience and understand myself more clearly.
Writing helps me turn scattered lessons into context I can return to later.

items.title: Experiencing a bigger world
points: Travel, films, and games keep reminding me that strong experiences come from rhythm, detail, and structure working together.
